name: ctx-cards
description: Contextual definition cards driven by schema.org DefinedTermSet. One script tag, no dependencies.

scripts.build: terser src/ctx.js -c passes=2 -m --format preamble="/*! ctx-cards v0.5.0 | MIT | github.com/JakeLabate/ctx-cards */" -o dist/ctx.min.js && cp src/ctx.js dist/ctx.js
